├── 📖 README.md                    # Quick start guide
│
├── 🔦 lighthouse/
│   └── lighthouserc.json          # Performance audit configuration
│
└── ⚙️  workflows/
    ├── 🐳 docker-build.yml         # Multi-arch Docker image builds
    ├── 🧪 backend-ci.yml           # Backend testing & validation
    ├── 🎨 dashboard-ci.yml         # Frontend testing & performance
    ├── 🔒 security-scan.yml        # Security vulnerability scanning
    ├── 📦 release.yml              # Automated release management
    ├── ✅ pr-checks.yml            # Pull request validation
    ├── 📊 code-quality.yml         # Code quality checks
    ├── 🔄 dependency-updates.yml   # Automated dependency updates
    ├── 🏷️  basic-support-info.yml  # Issue template validation
    └── 🗑️  stale.yml               # Stale issue management

Root Configuration Files:
├── .markdownlint.json             # Markdown linting rules
└── .yamllint.yml                  # YAML linting configuration

Updated Files:
├── src/backend/package.json       # Added CI/CD scripts
└── src/dashboard/package.json     # Added test script


🚀 WORKFLOWS OVERVIEW
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 🐳 DOCKER BUILD                                                             │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Triggers: Push, PR, Manual                                                  │
│ • Builds all Docker images for amd64 & arm64                                │
│ • Publishes to GitHub Container Registry                                    │
│ • Uses build caching for speed                                              │
│ • Matrix build for all honeypot services                                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 🧪 BACKEND CI                                                               │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Triggers: Push to backend/, PR                                              │
│ • TypeScript compilation checks                                             │
│ • Tests on Node.js 18.x & 20.x                                              │
│ • Docker image validation                                                   │
│ • Build artifact uploads                                                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 🎨 DASHBOARD CI                                                             │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Triggers: Push to dashboard/, PR                                            │
│ • ESLint code quality checks                                                │
│ • Production build verification                                             │
│ • Lighthouse performance audits                                             │
│ • Docker image testing                                                      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 🔒 SECURITY SCANNING                                                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Triggers: Push, PR, Daily @ 2AM UTC, Manual                                 │
│ • npm audit for vulnerabilities                                             │
│ • CodeQL static analysis                                                    │
│ • Trivy container scanning                                                  │
│ • TruffleHog secret detection                                               │
│ • Results uploaded to Security tab                                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 📦 RELEASE MANAGEMENT                                                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Triggers: Version tags (v*), Manual                                         │
│ • Creates GitHub release                                                    │
│ • Generates changelog                                                       │
│ • Builds & publishes Docker images                                          │
│ • Creates installer package                                                 │
│ • Generates checksums                                                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ ✅ PULL REQUEST CHECKS                                                      │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Triggers: PR opened/updated                                                 │
│ • Semantic PR title validation                                              │
│ • File change detection                                                     │
│ • Component-specific testing                                                │
│ • ShellCheck for scripts                                                    │
│ • Automatic size labeling                                                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 📊 CODE QUALITY                                                             │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Triggers: Push, PR, Manual                                                  │
│ • ShellCheck analysis                                                       │
│ • YAML linting                                                              │
│ • Dockerfile linting (Hadolint)                                             │
│ • EditorConfig validation                                                   │

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 🔄 DEPENDENCY UPDATES                                                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤

│ • Security vulnerability fixes                                              │

│ • Automatic PR creation                                                     │

✨ KEY FEATURES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

✅ Multi-Architecture Support
   • linux/amd64 (x86_64 servers)
   • linux/arm64 (Raspberry Pi, ARM servers)

✅ Automated Testing
   • Backend: TypeScript, Node.js 18.x & 20.x
   • Frontend: ESLint, Build verification, Lighthouse

✅ Security First
   • Daily vulnerability scans
   • Secret detection
   • Container security
   • CodeQL analysis

✅ Release Automation
   • Tag-based releases
   • Changelog generation
   • Multi-arch image publishing
   • Installer packages

✅ Quality Gates
   • Semantic PR validation
   • Code quality checks
   • Component-specific testing
   • Automated size labeling

✅ Dependency Management
   • Weekly updates
   • Security patches
   • Automatic PRs

🔧 QUICK COMMANDS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Test backend locally
cd src/backend && npm ci && npm run build && npm test

# Test dashboard locally
cd src/dashboard && npm ci && npm run lint && npm run build

# Build Docker images
./docker-build.sh

# Create a release
echo "24.04.1" > version
git add version
git commit -m "chore: bump version to 24.04.1"
git tag v24.04.1
git push origin main --tags

# View workflow status
gh workflow list
gh run list


💡 TIPS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

• All workflows use GitHub Actions cache for faster builds
• Docker images are automatically tagged with branch names and versions
• Security scans run daily and results appear in the Security tab
• PR checks enforce semantic commit messages (feat, fix, docs, etc.)
• Dependencies are automatically updated weekly with PRs
• Build artifacts are retained for 7-30 days
